Hymn 283: The Glorious Gospel Light Has Shone
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major

This is hymn number 283 titled "The Glorious Gospel Light Has Shone" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Carolee Curtis Green and the lyrics were written by Joel H. Johnson.
